# Amazon Bedrock Doc History — captured 2026-08-07
Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/doc-history.html

Top rows:
- Jul 30, 2026 — Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic is no longer open to new customers. Existing customers
  continue as normal; AWS points new work at Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. [DEPRECATION — not reportable]
- Jun 30, 2026 — Advance notice of the same Agents Classic availability change. [already cached]

API Reference welcome page groups unchanged: Amazon Bedrock, Agents for Amazon Bedrock (now "Classic",
carrying the maintenance-mode note), Agents for Amazon Bedrock Runtime, Data Automation for Amazon
Bedrock, Runtime for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation, Amazon Bedrock Runtime.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Only deprecations. No new services, APIs or entity types. Nothing reportable.
Coverage note: the Agents Classic closure means net-new AWS agent surface will land in AgentCore —
see amazon-bedrock-agentcore_changelog.txt, which had a large delta this scan.
